purpose: Correct APPLIES / DOES_NOT_APPLY decisions; penalizes over-flagging absent non-applicable clauses
evidence_basis: 18/18 rows scored. Metadata gates cross-checked programmatically against Project_Metadata-6cfb1c3d.json; clause inventory reconciled against all 5 source PDFs.
observed_result: 14 APPLIES / 4 DOES_NOT_APPLY. All 6 metadata-gated requirements matched expected decision (CC-01 federal_aid=No, CC-09 buy_america_baba_applicable=No, CC-14 subcontracting_planned=No, CC-15 claim_event=No -> DOES_NOT_APPLY; CC-16 delay_event=Yes, CC-18 changed_work_event=Yes -> APPLIES). Every one of the 14 clause blocks physically present in the package (5 in Proposal, 7 in General Conditions, 1 in Special Provisions, 1 revision in Addendum B) is marked APPLIES; zero present-clause was suppressed as DOES_NOT_APPLY.
issues_found: None. Critically, the two Critical-severity items (CC-01 FHWA-1273, CC-09 Buy America/BABA) were NOT flagged for absence - the dominant over-flagging trap on a non-federal-aid package.
residual_risk: Low. CC-14/CC-15 rest on metadata alone; if subcontracting or a claim later arises the decisions must be revisited.

purpose: Find material deviations without unsupported flags
evidence_basis: Each of the 14 applicable clauses compared line-by-line against its Challenge_Reference_Rule in Reference_Checklist.csv.
observed_result: 5 FLAGs raised: CC-05 (45 vs 20 calendar days; proof of insurance not required before execution), CC-08 (later-issued addenda may be disregarded), CC-11 (oral direction immediately modifies scope/price/time), CC-13 (prime-only audit, 1-year vs 3-year retention), CC-18 (fixed 25% markup replacing unit-price/negotiated/force-account sequence). Each maps to an explicit contradiction of a reference rule quoted verbatim from the source PDF. Recall: every planted deviation carrying explicit contradicting language was captured. Precision: no FLAG rests on omission-only reasoning.
issues_found: No unsupported flags. The one deviation deliberately cured by addendum (CC-17) was correctly NOT flagged.
residual_risk: Moderate on CC-07 and CC-12, held at NO_FLAG/Low. Both incorporate reference timing by cross-reference rather than restating it (CC-07 omits the 30-day/10-day/20-day intervals; CC-12 omits immediate oral notice, the proceed-only-after-written-direction condition, and the 7-calendar-day follow-up). If the rubric treats incorporation-by-reference as substantive weakening, these are 2 missed FLAGs.

purpose: Select correct governing document when proposal/special provisions/Addenda conflict
evidence_basis: Addendum revision map built programmatically: Addendum A revises nothing; Addendum B revises exactly one named provision (Liquidated damages schedule / rate logic).
observed_result: CC-17 resolved correctly: Special Provisions '$10,000 per calendar day ... regardless of contract value or governing schedule' is superseded by Addendum B REPLACEMENT TEXT restoring the governing schedule. governing_document set to Addendum_B-89644988.pdf and predicted_label NO_FLAG, per the checklist rule that a later Addendum explicitly revising a named provision governs. Addendum A correctly treated as a no-change distractor that cures nothing - CC-04 and CC-05 remain governed by General_Conditions. governing_document is populated on all 18 rows and every value resolves to a real package file.
issues_found: None. Both directions of the precedence trap handled: the real supersession was honoured, and the decoy addendum was not credited with curing CC-05.
residual_risk: Low. Dependency noted in-report: the CC-08 clause purporting to allow later addenda to be disregarded would, if honoured, reinstate the non-compliant $10,000 flat rate - this interaction is cross-referenced in both the CC-08 and CC-17 rows.

purpose: Separate material changes from equivalent/paraphrased wording
evidence_basis: Nine applicable clauses were judged compliant or benign despite non-identical wording.
observed_result: Correctly held as equivalent paraphrase, not deviation: CC-02 ('acceptable bid security equal to ten percent (10%) of the total bid price' = reference 10% proposal guaranty, despite the 'bid security' vs 'proposal guaranty' label change); CC-03 (heading-case variation on the non-collusion certification, expressly benign under the rule); CC-04 (100% coverage plus surety-condition qualifier, wording reordered); CC-06 ('before beginning covered field work' preserves the pre-performance registration condition); CC-16 (retains excusable-delay conditions, timely support, demonstrated effect on contract time, and 'not automatic for every delay'). These were graded Info, not escalated.
issues_found: None material. CC-10 and CC-16 use compressed paraphrases ('order of precedence supplied in the applicable contract documents', 'effect on contract time' rather than 'critical path/substantial completion') that were read as equivalent rather than weakened.
residual_risk: Moderate. The judgement boundary between Info (benign paraphrase) and Low (incomplete restatement) drives CC-07, CC-10, CC-12 and CC-16; a stricter rubric could reclassify one or more.

evidence_basis: Automated audit of the delivered CSV: verbatim substring match of every quoted draft_evidence sentence against the preprocessed extracted text of the 5 PDFs plus the metadata JSON; reference_location checked to contain the exact Section value from Reference_Checklist.csv.
observed_result: 18/18 rows passed. Zero non-verbatim quotations, zero empty required fields, all 15 schema fields present in schema order, all reference_id values equal to requirement_id, all draft_location values resolve to a real file plus section/page, all reference_location values carry the authoritative section (FHWA-1273 I.1, DelDOT 102.8, 102.15, 103.5, 103.7, 19 Del. C. 3604, 29 Del. C. 6967, Attachments/Addenda, Buy America Requirement, DelDOT 105.6, 104.2, 104.3, Right to Audit, 108.1, 105.15, 108.7, 108.9, 109.4). purpose: Reasonable agreement with challenge severity labels
evidence_basis: Every FLAG severity compared against the Severity_Guidance column of Reference_Checklist.csv and the working definitions in Severity_Guidance.csv.
observed_result: All 5 FLAG rows match the checklist's prescribed severity exactly: CC-05 High, CC-08 High, CC-11 High (material required protection or workflow missing/substantially weakened), CC-13 Medium, CC-18 Medium (procedural, record-retention, and pricing deviations). Distribution: 3 High, 2 Medium, 2 Low, 11 Info. No FLAG carried Info; no DOES_NOT_APPLY row carried an escalated severity.
issues_found: CC-07 and CC-12 carry Low on NO_FLAG rows. Severity_Guidance defines Low as not changing the intended substantive requirement, so the pairing is internally consistent, and the note says Low 'may be used sparingly' - used on 2 of 18 rows.
residual_risk: Low. If the rubric requires NO_FLAG to always pair with Info, CC-07 and CC-12 would each lose partial credit.
